tests.name: Remove old orders for the isolated owner

data.sql: DELETE FROM bank_orders WHERE player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank_skip_qa');

tests.name: Create the owner's zero-balance account using ordinary deposits and withdrawals
Withdraw the deposited credit so the scheduled order is underfunded
Create daily order that cannot be paid at its first occurrence
Enable deterministic clock for the actual registered bank scheduler

data.sql: INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES('test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled','1','int') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='1',type='int';

tests.name: Make only standing-order scheduler due at the configured occurrence

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=(name='bank_standing_orders_tick'),next_due_at=CASE WHEN name='bank_standing_orders_tick' THEN to_timestamp(@{bank_skip_due}) ELSE next_due_at END;

tests.name: Run the actual bank scheduler at the first due time
Confirm one insufficient occurrence was skipped without debit, debt or cancellation

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN b.enabled AND b.last_occurrence_at IS NOT NULL AND b.next_run_at>b.last_occurrence_at AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_order_occurrences o WHERE o.bank_orders_id=b.bank_orders_id AND o.outcome='skipped_insufficient_funds' AND o.amount=25)=1 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=b.player_id AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bank_transactions WHERE tx_group_id LIKE 'bank-order-'||b.bank_orders_id||'-%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM bank_orders b WHERE b.bank_orders_id=@{bank_skip_order_id};
